scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @lucid-fin/desktop-renderer run build:dev && pnpm --filter @lucid-fin/desktop-main run dev
scripts.test:target: vitest run apps/desktop-renderer/src/target apps/desktop-renderer/src/target-entry.test.tsx apps/desktop-renderer/vite.target-rc.config.test.ts apps/desktop-main/src/target packages/target-contracts/src packages/target-storage/src packages/target-storage/test/i2h packages/target-storage/test/i7 packages/target-runtime/src scripts/build-target-rc.test.ts scripts/check-ipc-migration-allowlist.test.ts scripts/check-target-only-rc.test.ts scripts/generate-target-contracts.test.ts scripts/generate-target-preload.test.ts scripts/i0-baseline.test.ts scripts/migrate-legacy-skills.sqlite.test.ts scripts/migrate-legacy-skills.test.ts scripts/seal-legacy-browser-state.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage:critical: vitest run --config vitest.coverage-critical.config.ts src/logger.test.ts src/startup-metrics.test.ts src/electron.startup.test.ts src/llm-provider-runtime.test.ts src/bootstrap/init-app.test.ts src/ipc/handlers/commander.handlers.logging.test.ts src/ipc/handlers/commander-meta.handlers.test.ts src/ipc/handlers/task-list.handlers.test.ts --coverage
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @lucid-fin/desktop-main run pack
